{{Quote|Try not to be seen, if you can help it. CorSec don't take too kindly to this kind of thing. Also, this guy, name's Wililikin, will probably not be alone, so expect a fight.|Zekka Thyne|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Wililikin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal and [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Zekka Thyne (Bothan)|Zekka Thyne]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Wililikin]]
[[File:SlicerFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Wililikin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Wilikin spawned under eight possible Human depictions, four male, and four female. Because the quest dialogue identified Wililikin as male, this article assumes one of the four Human male depictions is canon. Furthermore, although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining him revealed him to be a terrorist. However, it should be noted that this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of Wililikin being placed under the randomized terrorist spawn template appearance.
